title: Crunchy Japanese-Style Crispy Pork Cutlet
description: A crispy Japanese-style pork cutlet recipe using juicy pork and crunchy crumb topping. Serve with a side of steamed vegetables for a well-rounded meal.

ingredients.name: pork cutlet
ingredients.notes: 1 pound of pork cutlet, preferably boneless and lean

ingredients.name: juicy
ingredients.notes: 1 cup of buttermilk or yogurt for marinating the pork

ingredients.name: eggs
ingredients.notes: beaten eggs for coating the pork

ingredients.name: flour
ingredients.notes: all-purpose flour for coating the pork

instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, eggs, and buttermilk.
2. Add the pork cutlet to the marinade and coat evenly.
3. Let the pork marinate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Preheat a non-stick skillet or a deep fryer to 375°F (190°C).
5. Dredge the marinated pork in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
6. Dip the floured pork in the beaten eggs, making sure to coat evenly.
7. Coat the egg-coated pork in the Japanese-style panko breadcrumbs.
8. Fry the breaded pork until golden brown and crispy, about 3-4 minutes per side.
9. Place the fried pork on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
10. Serve the crispy pork cutlet with sliced tomatoes and a side of steamed vegetables.
